ui.stats.history-note: History starts at match initialization and includes elimination/end. Regular samples begin every 30 seconds and become coarser in long matches; plotted lines connect the actual samples. Income per minute averages the period between adjacent samples.
ui.stats.army-note: Army counts exclude builders and harvesters, and include transported units. Value uses authored recruitment costs in each resource separately; units without a recipe contribute to counts only.
ui.stats.types-note: Built means completed output. Starting kits, sales, cancellations and surrender cleanup are not combat losses or production.
ui.stats.orders-note: Order APM counts accepted gameplay commands per active Force minute. Selection/camera inputs and refusals are excluded; pending orders count once when queued. Each eligible acting Force is counted once. Bot controllers are labeled separately.
